The Black exterior pairs with a spacious interior trimmed in perforated Vienna leather, creating an inviting environment for all passengers. The 2.0L TSI turbocharged engine delivers power efficiently while the eight-speed automatic transmission balances performance with practical fuel economy at 18 city and 25 highway miles per gallon.  The cabin prioritizes passenger comfort with heated and actively ventilated front bucket seats, heated rear seating, and an illuminated overhead console. Climate control extends throughout with rear air conditioning and automatic temperature management across dual front zones. Entertainment and connectivity are handled through Bluetooth integration, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and the comprehensive navigation system.  Safety technology includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag system. Electronic Stability Control, traction control with speed-sensing steering, and a comprehensive brake assist system work together to maintain control across varying road conditions. The emergency communication system VW Car-Net Safe & Secure provides five years of connected safety features.  Practical features round out the package: power liftgate for convenient cargo access, exterior parking camera, rain-sensing wipers with rear window wiper, and 20-inch two-tone machined alloy wheels. The power moonroof panoramic design amplifies the cabin's sense of openness and light.  Whether you're managing daily commutes, weekend adventures, or family road trips, this Atlas provides the space, capability, and features to handle each situation with composure. We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this vehicle firsthand.  Rosen, Rosen, Rosen! description: Discover refined efficiency and dependable performance with this 2025 Toyota Camry LE, finished in sophisticated silver that turns heads on every drive.  - 8-Way Power-Adjustable Front Driver's Seat with power lumbar support - Smart Key System with push button start and smart access on front doors and trunk - Leather-Wrapped Heated Steering Wheel - Heated Front Seats - Auto-Dimming Rearview Mirror with HomeLink - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration - SiriusXM satellite radio - Fully Automatic Headlights with delay-off feature - Automatic Dual-Zone Climate Control with rear window defroster - Exterior Parking Camera with rear view - Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control - Emergency Communication System with Safety Connect - Four-Wheel Independent Suspension - 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS  The Camry LE pairs a 2.5L 4-Cylinder engine with an eCVT transmission and standard all-wheel drive, delivering an impressive 51 city and 49 highway MPG. This combination ensures you spend less time at the pump while enjoying responsive, confident handling in all weather conditions. The efficient powertrain makes this sedan an smart choice for drivers who value both performance and fuel economy.  Comfort is thoughtfully engineered throughout this Camry. The driver's seat offers eight-way power adjustment with lumbar support to dial in your perfect driving position, while heated seats and a leather-wrapped heated steering wheel provide warmth on cold mornings. description: UNLIMITED ADVENTURE, ELECTRIFIED PERFORMANCE, ONE-OWNER, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, THE ULTIMATE OPEN-AIR OFF-ROADER! The 2025 Jeep Wrangler 4xe Backcountry 4x4 combines legendary Wrangler capability with advanced plug-in hybrid technology, creating one of the most versatile adventure vehicles ever built. Whether you're navigating city streets in near-silent electric operation, conquering challenging off-road trails, or enjoying open-air freedom with the roof removed, the Wrangler 4xe delivers an experience unlike anything else on the road. Built upon Jeep's iconic Trail Rated foundation and enhanced by its sophisticated plug-in hybrid powertrain, the Wrangler 4xe Backcountry delivers exceptional capability without sacrificing efficiency. Instant electric torque, proven four-wheel-drive hardware, and premium comfort features make every journey equally exciting, whether it's your daily commute or your next off-road adventure. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Wrangler has long been the benchmark for off-road capability, but the 4xe has expanded that reputation by adding impressive electric driving capability and significantly improved on-road refinement. Buyers appreciate the ability to complete many daily trips on electric power alone while still having the confidence of a gasoline engine for long-distance adventures. The Backcountry is one of the most distinctive Wrangler special editions offered by Jeep. Built specifically for drivers who enjoy exploring beyond the pavement without sacrificing everyday comfort, it combines premium technology, rugged trail equipment, and exclusive styling details into one exceptionally desirable package. This one-owner example is further enhanced by the Technology Group, factory navigation, integrated off-road camera, steel bumpers, body-color hardtop, and numerous premium features that make it equally comfortable on the highway and exceptionally capable on the trail. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition The Jeep Wrangler continues to stand alone as one of the world's most recognizable and capable off-road vehicles. The Wrangler 4xe has earned additional praise for combining Jeep's legendary trail capability with modern electrified performance and improved efficiency. Reviewers consistently applaud the Wrangler 4xe for its remarkable torque, impressive off-road capability, removable roof and doors, and ability to complete many everyday drives using electric power alone. MotorTrend SUV of the Year finalist Trail Rated by Jeep Widely recognized as one of the world's most capable production off-road vehicles Praised for combining electrification with authentic Jeep capability Warranty The odometer is hovering around the 16,901-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. Basic Limited Warranty Covers nearly every major component of the vehicle against defects in materials or workmanship. Expires May 12, 2028 or 36,000 miles, whichever comes first. Powertrain Limited Warranty Covers the engine, transmission, transfer case, and covered drivetrain components. Expires May 12, 2030 or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first. High-Voltage Battery Limited Warranty Covers the high-voltage battery system and related hybrid components. Expires May 12, 2033 or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first. Want to extend its warranty coverage? In most cases, we can provide expanded options to help protect your investment with valuable, comprehensive coverage for years to come! Standard Features The Wrangler 4xe Backcountry combines rugged Jeep capability with modern comfort and premium technology. Durable materials, intuitive controls, and thoughtful storage solutions create an interior that's ready for both everyday commuting and serious adventure. Removable roof panels, removable doors, a fold-flat windshield, and a versatile cargo area allow owners to customize the Wrangler experience unlike virtually any other vehicle available today. Installed Options This Wrangler 4xe Backcountry was ordered with an exceptional collection of factory equipment that enhances off-road capability, technology, appearance, and everyday comfort. Package: Backcountry Package Created exclusively for adventure-minded drivers, the Backcountry Package combines premium trail equipment with distinctive styling and convenience features that make this Wrangler equally at home exploring remote trails or cruising through town. Body-Color 3-Piece Hard Top Provides year-round comfort while retaining the Wrangler's signature removable Freedom Panels for open-air driving. Body-Color Rubicon Highline Fender Flares Distinctive high-clearance fender flares provide a more aggressive appearance while allowing additional tire clearance for off-road adventures. Rock Protection Rails Heavy-duty steel rails help protect the body when navigating rocky trails and challenging terrain. Steel Front and Rear Bumpers Durable steel bumpers provide increased protection while reinforcing the Wrangler's rugged appearance. Integrated Off-Road Camera Displays a forward-facing camera view to help identify obstacles that may not be visible from the driver's seat during technical trail driving. Jeep 4xe Power Box Allows the high-voltage battery to power external electrical devices, making campsites, tailgates, and remote work locations even more convenient. Package: Technology Group Designed to keep you connected both on and off the pavement, the Technology Group equips the Wrangler with Jeep's latest infotainment and navigation technologies while making every adventure more enjoyable. Uconnect 5 NAV with 12.3-Inch Touchscreen Jeep's largest available touchscreen integrates navigation, wireless smartphone connectivity, off-road information, and vehicle settings into one intuitive interface. Integrated GPS Navigation Factory navigation provides reliable turn-by-turn guidance, even in areas where cellular service may be limited. Connected Travel & Traffic Services Delivers live traffic information and travel updates through compatible connected services. 7-Inch Premium Digital Driver Information Display Configurable digital instrument cluster that places essential vehicle information directly within the driver's line of sight. HD Radio Package: Trailer Tow and Auxiliary Switch Group Designed for owners who plan to tow recreational equipment or add aftermarket accessories while maintaining factory integration. Factory Trailer Hitch Receiver 7-Pin & 4-Pin Trailer Wiring Harness Auxiliary Switch Bank for Accessory Integration Standalone Features Black Clear-Coat Exterior Paint A timeless premium finish that beautifully complements the Backcountry's exclusive exterior styling. Charging, Range & Electrified Powertrain The Wrangler 4xe combines a 2.0-liter turbocharged engine with two electric motors to produce a combined 375 horsepower and 470 lb-ft of torque. Instant electric torque enhances both off-road capability and everyday acceleration while maintaining impressive efficiency. When new, the Wrangler 4xe offered an EPA-estimated 21 miles of all-electric driving range, allowing many daily commutes and local errands to be completed without using gasoline. When additional range is needed, the gasoline engine seamlessly works alongside the hybrid system for long-distance travel. Level 1 Charging (120V Household Outlet) Fully recharge the battery in approximately 12 hours using a standard household outlet. Level 2 Charging (240V Home or Public Charger) Fully recharge the battery in approximately 2 to 3 hours using compatible Level 2 charging equipment. Hybrid Operation Automatically blends gasoline and electric power for exceptional performance and impressive overall driving range. Truck Capability Although legendary for its off-road prowess, the Wrangler 4xe remains a remarkably capable utility vehicle for towing and recreation. Drivetrain Jeep's Rock-Trac-inspired four-wheel-drive hardware, Selec-Trac Full-Time 4WD system, and instant electric torque work together to provide exceptional traction across mud, sand, rocks, snow, and loose terrain. Towing Properly equipped, the Wrangler 4xe is capable of towing up to approximately 3,500 pounds, making it well suited for small campers, utility trailers, motorcycles, and personal watercraft. Actual towing capacity should always be verified using the certification label and owner's manual. Cargo Area The versatile rear cargo compartment, fold-flat rear seating, removable roof panels, and swing-out tailgate provide outstanding flexibility for camping gear, outdoor equipment, and everyday hauling. Mechanical Features Jeep's advanced plug-in hybrid drivetrain pairs instant electric torque with a responsive turbocharged engine, creating one of the most capable electrified off-road systems available today. The Trail Rated suspension, Selec-Trac Full-Time 4WD system, locking differentials, advanced traction management, and exceptional ground clearance allow this Wrangler to confidently tackle terrain that would stop most SUVs in their tracks. The integrated electric powertrain also provides smooth, controlled low-speed operation that's especially beneficial during technical off-road driving. Exterior Features The Wrangler Backcountry combines unmistakable Jeep styling with exclusive factory enhancements that set it apart from ordinary Wranglers. Body-color hardtop, body-color highline fender flares, steel bumpers, aggressive all-terrain tires, premium 20-inch wheels, LED lighting, and exclusive Backcountry badging create an appearance that's every bit as capable as the vehicle itself. Interior Features Inside, the Wrangler balances rugged durability with modern comfort. Premium seating, durable materials, intuitive controls, and generous passenger accommodations create an environment that's equally comfortable during daily commuting or extended adventures. The removable Freedom Panels allow occupants to enjoy open-air driving while maintaining the convenience of a weather-tight hardtop whenever conditions demand it. Infotainment & Technology Jeep's latest Uconnect 5 system delivers one of the most intuitive infotainment experiences available in an off-road vehicle. Wireless Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Uconnect 5 Navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, HD Radio, SiriusXM Satellite Radio (subscription may be required), Connected Travel & Traffic Services, multiple USB charging ports, voice recognition, and Off-Road Pages keep both driver and passengers informed and entertained. Safety Features The Wrangler 4xe incorporates a comprehensive collection of modern safety technologies while preserving the rugged capability that has defined the Wrangler for generations. Adaptive Cruise Control, Full-Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus, Blind Spot Monitoring, Rear Cross Path Detection, ParkSense Front and Rear Park Assist, ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera, Integrated Off-Road Camera, electronic stability control, traction control, multiple airbags, and advanced brake assist all work together to inspire confidence both on and off the pavement. ... and there's SO MUCH more!
